item.title: Camo developer sues Apple for copying its tech with Continuity Camera
item.description: Apple has been hit with a new lawsuit by Reincubate, the company behind the Camo and Camo Studio apps that let you use your iPhone as a webcam for your Mac. Reincubate accuses Apple of copying its technology when it launched Continuity Camera in 2022. Continuity Camera is Apple’s own similar first-party solution for using your iPhone as a webcam with your Mac. more…

item.title: Volvo says it will ‘absolutely’ continue offering CarPlay support
